text:
umi: Heads up — after today's console rollout that tightened route-stability and enabled `prefer-fast-path`, we saw a short-lived but sharp spike in resume churn for several tenants. Some customers reported duplicate billing.

felix: Can you paste a tiny repro from the proxy logs?

umi: Snip from edge-proxy logs:
```
2026-09-08T13:42:11.001Z INFO auth_resume session=sess-A token=tok-9 route=eu-core
2026-09-08T13:42:11.003Z WARN resume_no_ack session=sess-A
2026-09-08T13:42:11.005Z INFO route_update session=sess-A from=eu-core to=eu-fast trigger=prefer-fast-path
2026-09-08T13:42:11.006Z INFO auth_resume session=sess-A token=tok-9 route=eu-fast
```
Pattern: route flip happens between two resume events and runtime only ACKs the later one — billing currently counts the first edge resume as billable.

anika: Oof. Two quick notes: 1) console telemetry didn't surface `route` or the `prefer-fast-path` flag in the resume metric because our metric-proxy stripped unknown labels during the rollout, so we couldn't slice affected cohorts. 2) The console change reduced `route_stability_ms` to 0 for canary — that seems dangerously low.

harry: Short-term mitigation options: rollback the flag for canary cohort, or add server-side debounce to ignore duplicate resume for identical session+token within 1500ms. Which is faster?

felix: Debounce is fast to ship, but we should also stop billing on resume-attempt and require runtime ack before emitting charge. I'll open BILL-734 for the billing guard.

umi: Agreed — debounce now, billing guard longer-term. I'll flip the console rollback if debounce doesn't reduce retries in 10m.

anika: I'll hotpatch the metric-proxy to pass through new labels and add a temporary dashboard panel: resume_attempts vs resume_ack_lag by route and by console_cohort. That will make rollouts visible.

opsbot: Alert created: resume_attempts_per_session > 4 in 1m -> page eng-oncall.

felix: Implementation note for debounce: session-manager can respond 200 but set a `dedup_suppressed` metric and skip emitting the resume event to billing and downstream. We'll treat identical session+token resumes within 1500ms as deduped. Small PR, unit test included.

harry: Also, console UX should warn if a toggle reduces `route_stability_ms` below 500ms and require an explicit override. Filed UX-guard ticket.

umi: Nice. Action plan: 1) ship debounce PR to staging (felix) 2) patch metric-proxy (anika) 3) open billing guard (felix) 4) add console safety warning (harry). If retries >5/session after debounce, rollback the flag.

felix: Deploying debounce -> staging in 6m. Will monitor logs and the new dashboard panel once tags flow.

umi: Thanks team. Also notify CS for any tenants with anomalous billing after we identify them via backfilled metrics. :pray:
